newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung Fong Hung adjusts conv note price.
newsitem.headline: Tung Fong Hung adjusts conv note price.

text.p: Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd said it had adjusted the initial conversion price of its HK$200 million unsecured convertible loan notes to HK$0.46 per share from HK$0.55 per share.
The company said the conversion price was adjusted to reflect the company's proposal of a bonus share issue on the basis of one new share for every five existing shares held.
Upon full conversion of the note, a total 434.78 million shares or 17.0 percent of the enlarged share capital will be required to be issued, it said.
Earlier in December, Tung Fong Hung said it planned to issue HK$200 million in unsecured convertible loan notes. The three-year notes will carry an annual interest of seven percent.
